comparison.objective: Zero an unpowered robot joint and insert a calibration pin.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a heavy articulated link aligned to a datum while inserting a retaining pin.
comparison.success_condition: Link rests at the zero mark on the fully inserted pin after release.
comparison.reason: It shares calibration and retention, but retains a directly aligned joint with a pin rather than preserving a screw setting against locknut reaction and testing cycles.
